title: pontes.json: upcoming Portuguese long weekends
description: From the committed holiday calendar (content/holidays.yaml, Código do Trabalho art. 234 and 235; D31): every national holiday on a Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday gives a long weekend (Tuesday and Thursday with the working day in between bridged). Listed while its travel window has not ended (Lisbon date of meta.generated_at), by date. A low price fits a ponte when window.start <= departure <= holiday.date <= return <= window.end. No prices here: the site selects the matching rows of each origin's low-price file. Added in v1 (additive): an export without it has no meta.files.pontes.

source.description: Legal source of the calendar, to cite on the pages.

optional.description: true for Carnaval (art. 235): not every employer gives the day; say so.

bridge.description: The working day taken off between the holiday and the weekend (Tuesday/Thursday holidays); null when none is needed.

window.description: Travel window: from the evening before the first day off to the morning after the last one (the weekend rule's Friday/Monday).

origins.description: One page per origin of origins.json, in its order.
